University College “Cardenal Spínola” is affiliated to the University of Seville which means that all Erasmus+ students and teachers must apply to the International office there www.internacioal.us.es as well as applying to our college. The mobility experience allows them to practice the language, get to know other educational systems, meet foreign teachers as well as living the culture and customs of a Spanish speaking country.
